findings.summary: RedIron Construction, LLC incorporated in Louisiana on 2011-03-24 — verifiable primary entity behind Waller's wealth claims
findings.detail: OpenCorporates records confirm RedIron Construction, LLC (LA company 40464269K) incorporated 2011-03-24, status 'Active In Good Standing'. Registered address: 12318 Jefferson Highway, Baton Rouge, LA 70816. The same LLC is registered as a foreign LLC in Washington state (2022) and Alabama (2020), confirming multi-state operations. Commercial data sources (LeadIQ, Apollo) estimate revenue at ~$5.5M with 21-30 employees at the Baton Rouge location; one source cites 130+ employees and 50-state operations (unverified). Specializes in commercial pre-engineered metal buildings and structural steel erection. Clients cited in web sources include Costco and Rooms To Go (not Amazon as previously noted).

findings.summary: RedIron Construction LLC's registered domicile address (229 S Ardenwood, Baton Rouge) is a property personally owned by Justin Winn Waller (EBR assessment 005-3321-1), confirming Waller as sole beneficial owner with no separation between personal and corporate real property.
findings.detail: RedIron registered office: 229 S ARDENWOOD per SOS record. EBR parcel 005-3321-1 at 229 S ARDENWOOD DR is assessed to WALLER, JUSTIN WINN; FMV $17,248; last sold 2018. Taxpayer mailing address on that parcel is 4242 GOVERNMENT ST, the same address previously used as RedIron's mailing address.

findings.summary: RedIron Construction LLC's documented East Baton Rouge property footprint consists of 5 small lots in Greenville subdivision (Block 219, acquired 2018) with combined fair market value of approximately $2,986 — inconsistent with Justin Waller's public claims of a $10M–$70M real estate portfolio.
findings.detail: Parcels: 001-2210-6 (1632 North Blvd, FMV $2,046), 001-2064-2 (FMV $330), 001-5097-5 (FMV $280), 001-4654-4 (FMV $110), 000-4371-0 (FMV $220). All small adjacent lots on N Blvd / Carruth St. No commercial building of significance. Combined FMV ~$2,986. Justin Waller personally holds 2 additional EBR parcels (229 S Ardenwood Dr FMV $17,248; 528 Ingleside Dr FMV $19,425). Total documented EBR portfolio ~$39,659.

findings.summary: Justin Waller served as Tate network's proxy pitchman to evade platform bans; YouTube terminated his 4 channels (400K+ subs, 93M views) in 2024; real business is RedIron Construction (Amazon/Costco steel supplier)
findings.detail: Justin Waller was deployed by the Tate network as a proxy pitchman for The Real World on YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram after Tate himself was banned from those platforms. Waller's content directed viewers to TRW sign-up pages. In 2024 YouTube terminated Waller's four channels, which had a combined 400,000+ subscribers and 93 million views. Waller's legitimately operating business is RedIron Construction (founded 2011), a steel supplier for large commercial projects including Amazon and Costco distribution centers.

findings.summary: Waller's net worth and real estate portfolio claims are materially inconsistent across sources: 200-400+ units claimed, $10M-$70M net worth range
findings.detail: Justin Waller has claimed ownership of 'over 400 doors' (real estate units). However, other sources cite 200+ units across multiple states. Net worth estimates range from $10M to $70M across various sources, with most centering on $10-20M. Post-documentary reporting (The Tab, March 17, 2026) raised questions about the gap between claimed and verifiable net worth. RedIron Construction commercial data (LeadIQ/Apollo) estimates company revenue at only ~$5.5M — difficult to reconcile with claims of a $10-20M personal net worth from construction alone. No property records searched to date (ACRIS/LA property records not yet checked).

findings.summary: YouTube terminated 4 Waller channels (400K+ subs, 93M views) in January 2024 for circumventing Tate's prior ban — triggered by VICE News investigation
findings.detail: A VICE News investigation (published approx. January 27-28, 2024) exposed Justin Waller as the designated proxy pitchman for Andrew Tate's The Real World after Tate was banned from YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram. TRW tutors instructed students to build Waller-centered content to route around Tate bans. YouTube subsequently terminated 4 channels affiliated with Waller. YouTube spokesperson stated the reason was 'circumventing the termination of a previously terminated user' (TheRealWorld channel). Waller's main channel had 400K+ subscribers and 93M views. VICE journalist Tim Hume reported this on X (January 28, 2024).

findings.summary: Post-YouTube-ban platform footprint: Instagram (~1M followers claimed), X (@Waller7J), Spotify podcast, Rumble, and new JWaller Studios channel
findings.detail: After YouTube terminated his 4 channels in January 2024, Waller rebuilt on: Instagram (~1M followers claimed), X/Twitter (@Waller7J), Spotify podcast ('Justin Waller Podcast'), Rumble (active), and JWaller Studios (new channel). Skool profiles (skool.com/@jwaller) remain active. jwallerallies.com and jwallermastermind.com remain active as coaching landing pages.

findings.summary: Waller operates at least three monetized coaching products: JWALLER Group (Skool, $97-$397/mo), Allies Real Estate Coaching (jwallermastermind.com), and The Construct Collective (theconstructcollective.com)
findings.detail: JWALLER Group on Skool.com uses classic urgency pricing: listed at $97/month with warnings of imminent increase to $397/month (discounted from $247). The Allies Real Estate Coaching at jwallermastermind.com is a separate real estate investing program. The Construct Collective at theconstructcollective.com is a contractor-focused coaching program launched post-YouTube ban, promising to identify $20K-$50K in revenue losses in the first week. Coaching income estimated at $1-2M annually by third-party sources (unverified). No corporate registrations found for any of these coaching brands in registry searches.

findings.summary: Louis Theroux Netflix documentary 'Inside the Manosphere' (March 2026) featured Waller as principal subject — increased public scrutiny of income and lifestyle claims
findings.detail: Netflix documentary 'Louis Theroux: Inside the Manosphere' (released March 11, 2026, IMDB: tt39792948) featured Justin Waller prominently as 'Self - Manosphere Influencer'. Documentary reached #1 on Netflix. Revealed Waller's 'one-way monogamy' arrangement (wife Kristen, 2 children, third on the way). Theroux has noted Waller said pre-filming 'I know you're going to make me look like an a**hole... that's fine.' Post-documentary reporting (The Tab, March 17 and 24, 2026) scrutinized Waller's net worth claims. Increased investigative scrutiny of his construction business and real estate portfolio claims concurrent with documentary release.

findings.summary: Negative results: No FTC enforcement, no federal litigation (CourtListener), no EDGAR filings, no FARA registrations, no OpenSanctions flags found for Justin Waller or RedIron Construction
findings.detail: Exhaustive search across: CourtListener (party 'Justin Waller' — 1 result, Texas bankruptcy 2005 Levi Justin Waller, different person; party 'RedIron Construction' and 'RedIron' — 0 results); SEC EDGAR full-text search — 0 results; FARA database — 0 registrations; OpenSanctions — 0 results; FEC — 20 'Justin Waller' donors but none linked to Louisiana or construction, small amounts, different states; IRS 990 officer search — 6 results for 'Justin Waller' but none match Louisiana construction entrepreneur (COO of US Chamber of Commerce Foundation is different person). No USASpending federal contracts found for RedIron Construction. SAM.gov search not possible (API key unavailable).

findings.summary: Justin Winn Waller holds only 2 parcels in East Baton Rouge Parish totaling ~$318K FMV — no rental units
findings.detail: EBR Tax Roll and Tax Parcel searches under 'WALLER JUSTIN WINN' return exactly 2 unique assessment numbers: (1) Assessment 732761, Capital Heights Lot 28 Block 6, FMV $159,250, owner address 229 S Ardenwood Dr — personal residence; (2) Assessment 533211, Ardenwood Lot B PT, FMV $159,040, owner address 4242 Government St — commercial property. No apartment buildings, no multi-family parcels, no homestead exemption claimed. A third property (528 INGLESIDE DR) appears in parcel dataset with sale_year 2014, indicating prior ownership now terminated.

findings.summary: RedIron Construction LLC owns 5 vacant land parcels in EBR (Greenville Block 219, ~$24K FMV) — no rental units
findings.detail: RedIron Construction, LLC holds 5 unique parcel assessments in EBR, all in Greenville subdivision Block 219 (North Baton Rouge / Old Town Redevelopment District). Assessment 122106 (1632 North Blvd, 0.15 acres, FMV $14,190) is the primary parcel; four additional small fragments make up the assembly. All parcels are vacant land (existing_land_use=V), zoned C2, in Enterprise Zone and Economic Development Zone. No improvements, no rental units, no tenants. Combined FMV $23,590. Current registered owner address: 7515 Jefferson Hwy #304, Baton Rouge, LA 70808.

findings.summary: R3 Properties LLC (possibly Waller-linked via shared address at 4242 Government St) holds commercial/vacant parcels in EBR — no rental units
findings.detail: R3 Properties LLC files owner address as '4242 GOVERNMENT ST, BATON ROUGE, LA 70806' on Capital Heights parcels. This is the same building Justin Waller owns (Assessment 533211) and the same address RedIron Construction used as its business office 2020-2022. R3 holds 5 parcels: the commercial building at 4242 Government St (Lot 29, Block 6, Capital Heights, FMV $621,353), three adjacent vacant lots (Lots 30-32, Block 6, ~$50K each), and a commercial lot at Village at Magnolia Square ($911,800). All are commercial or vacant — no residential rental units. FMV $1.68M combined. Direct ownership linkage to Waller not confirmed via registry.

findings.summary: No evidence of a 200-400 unit residential rental portfolio under Waller or RedIron in East Baton Rouge Parish
findings.detail: EBR property records have been searched across Tax Roll, Tax Parcel, and Adjudicated datasets for all plausible Waller and RedIron entity variations. No records of residential apartment buildings, multi-family housing complexes, or rental unit portfolios were found under any name searched. The claim that Justin Waller owns 200-400 rental 'doors' finds zero evidentiary support in East Baton Rouge Parish — the parish where Waller is based and operates. Either the portfolio does not exist at the claimed scale, or holdings are concentrated in other Louisiana parishes (Ascension, Livingston, etc.) and/or held under LLC names not yet identified.

findings.summary: RedIron Construction LLC address history in EBR tax records: three locations 2018-2025
findings.detail: RedIron Construction LLC business address has migrated in EBR property records: 523 INGLESIDE DR (tax years 2018-2019) -> 4242 GOVERNMENT ST STE 109 (2020-2022) -> 7515 JEFFERSON HWY #304, BATON ROUGE, LA 70808 (2023-2025). All three addresses appear in the tax roll owner address field across different tax years for the same Greenville Block 219 parcels.

findings.summary: Justin Waller is both high-betweenness (rank 5, bw=0.140) and a perfect structural broker (brokerage=1.0) — his five neighbors (Tate, Andrew Tate, RedIron Construction, JWALLER Group, The Construct Collective, Chris Rood) are not directly connected to each other
findings.detail: Waller has degree=5 and brokerage=1.0 with clustering coefficient 0.0, placing him in the same pure-broker category as NMI and GBD. His position between the Tate cluster and his own RedIron/JWALLER/Construct Collective subgraph means he is the sole documented link between Tate's ecosystem and his real estate / coaching empire. No Waller entity connects directly to NEL, Talisman, or any payment processor — the bridge runs through Waller personally. This gap (no corporate edge Waller↔Tate) despite documented business collaboration is an investigation gap.
